title: Pass 3 reference table — solar-geometry constants, clear-sky beam transmittance, Beer-Lambert tier transmittance and latitude/tier-spacing benchmarks for ray-traced Honda tiered crowns
added_in: 2026-10-19-dichotomous-tree-branching-audit-v3 (Pass 3 remediation of the Pass 2 item 'couple 3D Honda tiered crowns to solar-elevation radiative transfer ray-tracing across diurnal sun paths; compare equatorial vs temperate optimal tier spacing')

solar_geometry_sources.citation: Campbell GS & Norman JM (1998) An Introduction to Environmental Biophysics, 2nd ed., Springer, Ch. 11 (Radiation fluxes in natural environments)
solar_geometry_sources.role: Spherical solar geometry sin h = sin phi sin delta + cos phi cos delta cos H (Eq. 11.1), solar azimuth (Eq. 11.2), day length cos H_0 = -tan phi tan delta (Eq. 11.6), clear-sky beam irradiance S_p = S_p0 * tau_atm^m with air mass m = 1/sin h and tau_atm ~ 0.75 for clear sky (Eq. 11.11)

solar_geometry_sources.citation: Cooper PI (1969) The absorption of radiation in solar stills. Solar Energy 12(3):333-346
solar_geometry_sources.role: Seasonal solar declination delta(n) = 23.45 deg * sin(360 deg * (284 + n) / 365) used for the 12 mid-month declinations of the annual sun-path integration

solar_geometry_sources.citation: Monsi M & Saeki T (1953) Ueber den Lichtfaktor in den Pflanzengesellschaften und seine Bedeutung fuer die Stoffproduktion. Japanese Journal of Botany 14:22-52 (English translation: Annals of Botany 95(3):549-567, 2005)
solar_geometry_sources.role: Beer-Lambert canopy extinction I/I_0 = exp(-K * LAI); for horizontal leaves K = 1 so per-tier beam transmittance tau_c = exp(-LAI_c) is independent of solar elevation

model_constants.tier_cluster_transmittance_note: tau_c = exp(-LAI_c) with LAI_c = 2.0 per leaf-cluster disk (Monsi & Saeki 1953, horizontal leaves K = 1); swept 0.0 (opaque) .. 1.0 (transparent ablation) in the script
model_constants.stem_cost_note: kappa is a free relative trunk-investment cost per unit s/R (pipe-model trunk volume is proportional to crown height (n-1)*s under Leonardo area conservation); it is NOT sourced from the literature and is reported only as a sensitivity sweep

latitude_benchmarks.analytic_note: cos H_0 = -tan(50.93 deg) tan(23.45 deg) -> H_0 = 122.3 deg -> 16.31 h (geometric, no refraction)

specimen_tier_spacing.method: inter-tier row spacing between consecutive detected foliage shelves / half-width of the lower shelf (foliage-mask column extent in a +-12 px band); projected, no perspective correction
specimen_tier_spacing.provenance_note: Computed by measure_specimen_tier_spacing() in 1976-honda-dichotomous-tree-branching.py on the SHA-256-pinned specimen; stored here for regression only (NOT an independent literature value)

model_predictions_pass3.note: Ray-traced outputs of evaluate_latitude_tier_spacing_tradeoff() at defaults; stored for regression only (NOT independent references)
